project_scope.selection_mode: San Marcos River Heteranthera-first aquatic lesson
project_scope.note: Current local lesson is intentionally species-centered because the family is morphologically broader than the single canonical anchor.

family_diagnostics.where_to_look_first: In the local Heteranthera anchor, find linear aquatic foliage plus a solitary yellow flower emerging from the water. Then inspect the 6-part perianth, 3 stamens, style/anther arrangement and capsule.
family_diagnostics.vegetative: Aquatic or wetland monocots; leaf form varies widely across the family.
family_diagnostics.flowers: Perianth commonly 6-parted; floral symmetry and stamen number vary by genus. Heteranthera dubia has a yellow salverform flower with three stamens.
family_diagnostics.fruit: Capsule in the local anchor, with relatively few winged seeds.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: Do not generalize the narrow grasslike leaves or yellow flower to all Pontederiaceae—those are Heteranthera traits.

visual_lesson.teaching_order: whole plant → high-value structure → reproductive confirmation → tie-breaker
visual_lesson.intro: Heteranthera dubia is a memorable family doorway because the grasslike aquatic foliage suddenly produces a bright yellow flower with unusual left/right reproductive handedness.

steps.title: 1 · Start with the aquatic habit
steps.look_for: Thin linear leaves on a submerged or procumbent aquatic plant.
steps.why_it_matters: The plant can look grasslike until it flowers.

steps.title: 2 · Find the solitary yellow flower
steps.look_for: One yellow flower with a long tube rising above the foliage.
steps.why_it_matters: The reproductive structure immediately breaks the grasslike illusion.

steps.title: 3 · Count three stamens
steps.look_for: Three equal stamens plus the style inside the 6-part flower.
steps.why_it_matters: This is a strong local genus/species confirmation.

steps.title: 4 · Compare mirror-image flowers
steps.look_for: Style and anthers positioned as left/right mirror images between flowers.
steps.why_it_matters: A powerful morphology lesson, even though it should not be the sole ID character.

comparisons.title: Pontederiaceae vs grasslike aquatics
comparisons.rule: Linear leaves alone are misleading. The showy 6-part flower and capsule place Heteranthera far from Poaceae.

visual_lesson.caveat: Use the Heteranthera lesson as a local anchor, not a universal visual definition of broad Pontederiaceae.
